# Animation tools

6 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `create_animation`

Create a new animation in an AnimationPlayer node

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | yes | Name for the new animation |
| `length` | `number` | — | Duration of the animation in seconds (default: 1.0) |
| `loop_mode` | `string` | — | Loop mode (default: none) One of: `"none"`, `"linear"`, `"pingpong"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-01:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim",
  "length": 1
}
```

## `add_animation_track`

Add a track to an existing animation (property, method, or Bezier track)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the animation to add a track to |
| `track_type` | `string` | — | Type of track to add (default: value) One of: `"value"`, `"method"`, `"bezier"`, `"audio"`, `"animation"`. |
| `target_path` | `string` | yes | NodePath to the target node (relative to AnimationPlayer's root), e.g. 'Sprite2D:position' |
| `interpolation` | `string` | — | Interpolation mode for value tracks (default: linear) One of: `"nearest"`, `"linear"`, `"cubic"`, `"linear_angle"`, `"cubic_angle"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim",
  "track_type": "value",
  "target_path": ".:position"
}
```

## `add_keyframe`

Add a keyframe to a track in an animation

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | yes | Animation name |
| `track_index` | `number` | yes | Track index (0-based). Use get_animation_info to find indices. |
| `time` | `number` | yes | Time position of the keyframe in seconds |
| `value` | any | yes | Value for the keyframe. Strings like 'Vector2(10,20)' are auto-converted. |
| `transition` | `number` | — | Transition easing (0.0–1.0 for ease-in/out). Default: 1.0 |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-04a:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim",
  "track_index": 0,
  "time": 0,
  "value": "Vector2(0, 0)"
}
```

## `set_easing`

Set the easing/transition curve of a keyframe in an animation track

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | yes | Animation name |
| `track_index` | `number` | yes | Track index (0-based) |
| `key_index` | `number` | yes | Keyframe index within the track |
| `transition` | `number` | — | Transition value. 1.0 = linear, <1 = ease-in, >1 = ease-out. Negative values create bounce effects. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim",
  "track_index": 0,
  "key_index": 0,
  "transition": "ease_in_out"
}
```

## `get_animation_info`

Get detailed info about an animation: tracks, keyframes, length, loop mode

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | — | Animation name. Omit to list all animation names. |
| `include_keyframes` | `boolean` | — | Include keyframe data for each track (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-02:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim"
}
```

## `delete_animation`

Delete an animation or remove a track from an animation

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the AnimationPlayer node |
| `animation_name` | `string` | yes | Animation name to delete or modify |
| `track_index` | `number` | — | If provided, only this track is removed instead of the whole animation |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/08-animation.json`, test AN-07:

```json
{
  "node_path": "AnimPlayer",
  "animation_name": "test_anim"
}
```
